CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
September 2, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

  RULES OF DECORUM - Click Here to View

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for August 5, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Liliger Damaso,
  representing Iconix Fitness, LLC for Special Use Permit
  No. 26-00003 (SUP26-00003) to allow 1) the on-site sale of
  beer, wine, and distilled spirits, 2) event center, and 3)
  live entertainment within an existing gymnasium that is
  part of the Hollywood Park Tomorrow retail center on an
  HPSP (Hollywood Park Specific Plan) zoned property at 1265
  South District Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-044) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-044;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00003.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Yvonne Lopez for
  Special Use Permit No. 26-00012 (SUP26-00012) to allow a
  barbershop within 300 feet of a similar establishment and a
  tattoo parlor in a one-story, multiple-tenant commercial
  building on a C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property at 1315
  North La Brea Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-079) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org.
 Preliminary Recommendations
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-079;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00012.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

c. A public hearing to consider an application by Jason Kho,
  representing Jon & Vinny’s, for a Special Use Permit No. 26-
  00018 (SUP26-00018) to allow the on-site sale of distilled
  spirits for a proposed restaurant and catering facility on an
  MU-2 (Mixed Use-2) zoned property at 207 West Beach Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-082) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.

Preliminary Recommendations:
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-082;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00018.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

d. A public hearing to consider an application by Charlie Taing,
  representing Randy’s Donuts and Chinese Food, for Special Use
  Permit No. 26-00019 (SUP26-00019) to allow the on-site sale of
  distilled spirits for a proposed approximately 2,700 square-foot
  restaurant that is part of a multiple tenant commercial building
  on a H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at 149-155 South Market
  Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-096) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

Preliminary Recommendations
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  a) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-096;
  b) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00019.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  a) Take the above actions, but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
   C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings;
  Item 6d Documents

  e. A public hearing to consider an application by Sodaism, Inc.,
  for Special Use Permit No. 26-00020 (SUP26-00020) to allow a
  large group counseling facility in an existing two-story
  commercial building on a C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property
  at 414 West Arbor Vitae Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-097) has been prepared finding

  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on

  Preliminary Recommendations

  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is

  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6e Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Charlie
  Taing, representing Randy’s Donuts and Chinese Food, for Design
  Review No. 26-00029 (DR26-00029) to allow exterior modifications
  for a proposed restaurant that is part of a multiple tenant
  commercial building on a H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at
  149-155 South Market Street.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-096) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  b. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-096;
  c. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00029.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  b. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  c. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.
 9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of September 2, 2026,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda
item being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda
item will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning
Commission meeting.
